{"path":"tools/generate_project_documentation.py","content":"import os import re from pathlib import Path # The path to the origin app source code target_folder = Path('react-origin-app/src') analysis_folder = Path('analysis') analysis_folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True) doc_file = analysis_folder / 'project_documentation.html' # Define regex patterns for route and component extraction route_pattern = re.compile(r']*path=["\f"A-Za-z0-9_/:%]+[^>]*>') component_pattern = re.compile(r'<([A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]*)\s?.*?>') # Function to extract routes and components from files def extract_routes_and_components(): routes = {} for file in target_folder.rglob('*.js'): with open(file, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f: content = f.read() for route in route_pattern.findall(content): route_path = re.search(r'path=["\f"A-Za-z0-9_/:%]+', route) route_component = component_pattern.search(route) if route_path and route_component: path = route_path.group().split('=')[1].strip('"') component = route_component.group(1) routes[path] = component return routes # Function to create mermaid content def create_mermaid(routes): mermaid_content = ["graph TD;"] mermaid_content.append(" A[Router]") for path, component in routes.items(): mermaid_content.append(f" A --> {component}[{component} - {path}]") return '\n'.join(mermaid_content) # Function to generate HTML documentation def generate_documentation(): routes = extract_routes_and_components() mermaid_diagram = create_mermaid(routes) html_content = f""" Project Documentation

Project Documentation

Routes Overview

    {mermaid_diagram}
""" with open(doc_file, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f: f.write(html_content) print(f"Documentation successfully generated at {doc_file}") if __name__ == "__main__": generate_documentation() "}
